Job Title: Metabolic Engineer (m/f/d) 

Microbial CO2 Transformation Specialist 

10 September 2026 

☀️About Us: 

Join the COLIPIan family as a Metabolic Engineer and help us develop next-generation microbial CO₂ transformation processes. 

At COLIPI, we are developing sustainable bioprocesses that use renewable carbon, including CO₂, to produce valuable microbial lipids and biomaterials. Our technology combines unconventional CO₂-utilizing microorganisms, metabolic engineering, and advanced fermentation to create sustainable alternatives to conventional lipid production. 

We are looking for an experienced scientist who can combine experimental strain engineering with metabolic modelling, systems biology, enzyme engineering, and bioinformatics to improve our production strains systematically. 

🧑🏽‍🔬Key Responsibilities: 

- Identify, design, and optimize metabolic pathways for converting CO₂ into lipids and other microbial storage molecules. 
- Develop and implement strain-engineering strategies, including gene knock-outs, overexpression, heterologous pathway expression, promoter engineering, plasmid-based engineering, and CRISPR/Cas-based approaches. 
- Establish, curate, and apply genome-scale metabolic models of our unconventional production strains to identify metabolic bottlenecks, predict engineering targets, and guide strain development. 
- Select and optimize heterologous enzymes and apply enzyme-engineering approaches to improve enzyme activity, stability, expression, and performance within the host microorganism. 
- Analyze and interpret transcriptomics, metabolomics, genomic, and sequencing data to understand cellular physiology and identify new engineering opportunities. 
- Apply bioinformatics tools for genome annotation, pathway analysis, sequence comparison, enzyme identification, and promoter/regulatory-element prediction. 
- Develop genetic tools and engineering strategies for COLIPI's unconventional CO₂-utilizing microbial strains. 
- Plan, execute, and analyze metabolic and genetic engineering experiments and translate results into iterative strain-development strategies. 
- Work closely with fermentation and analytical teams to evaluate engineered strains under relevant cultivation and gas-fermentation conditions. 

🛠️Qualifications: 

- PhD in Metabolic Engineering, Synthetic Biology, Systems Biology, Biotechnology, Biochemistry, Microbiology, or a related field, ideally combined with relevant academic and/or industry experience. 
- Strong background in microbial metabolic engineering, molecular biology, genetic engineering, and synthetic biology. 
- Hands-on experience with strain-engineering techniques such as knock-out/overexpression, cloning, heterologous gene expression, CRISPR/Cas, and directed evolution. 
- Demonstrated experience with genome-scale metabolic modelling and constraint-based metabolic analysis, ideally including model reconstruction or curation and experience with metabolic-modelling tools such as COBRApy, COBRA Toolbox, CellNetAnalyzer, etc.  
- Experience analyzing omics datasets, particularly transcriptomics and metabolomics, using computational and bioinformatics tools. 
- Good programming and data-analysis skills, ideally in Python and/or R. 
- Knowledge of enzyme engineering, protein structure-function relationships, and optimization of heterologous enzymes for activity and stability in thermophilic host microbe. 
- Strong understanding of microbial physiology, central carbon metabolism, carbon fixation pathways, metabolic regulation, and cellular redox/cofactor metabolism. 
- Familiarity with fermentation processes; experience with gas fermentation, autotrophic organisms, C1 metabolism, or non-model microorganisms is a strong advantage. 
- Experience with lipid/fatty-acid metabolism or engineering of acetyl-CoA and malonyl-CoA pathways is advantageous. 
- Ability to work independently, develop scientific strategies, and contribute to building and leading a highly effective strain-engineering team. 
- Legal permit to work in Europe, fluent in English (German B2 advantageous). 
- Willingness to embrace startup dynamics and help establish scalable scientific processes for future growth. 

🥰We Offer: 

- Competitive salary and 28 days of paid holidays 
- Steep learning and growth curve 
- Laptop and personal safety gear (goggles, coat, shoes) and training  
- Be part of an international team, blending academia with passionate startup vibes 
- Work on groundbreaking climate action technology with Europe's leading microbial carbon capture experts 
- Embrace an open feedback culture, flat hierarchies, and short decision-making processes 
- Access a fully equipped lab, cutting-edge technology, and ample room for personal development 
- Participation in advanced training programs 
- Annual performance appraisal meeting with manager, in addition to more frequent feedback and growth meetings 

⛵️Location: Hamburg, Germany 

- Enjoy the vibrant atmosphere of the 2nd biggest city and 1st ranked city to live in Germany. 
- Experience unique maritime charm and blazing nightlife. 
- Immerse yourself in a city rich in cultural events, museums, and galleries. 

If you are passionate about leveraging biology to tackle climate challenges and want to be part of a dynamic team shaping the future, apply now to contribute to our mission at COLIPI. 

A meaningful application via https://colipi.odoo.com/jobs (https://colipi.odoo.com/jobs) will include your 

- CV as PDF (no portrait photo needed) 
- Transcript of records (university) 
- Peer reviewed publications you contributed to 
- Success stories in academia and industry

Please note:  Applicants must have the  legal right to work in Germany . This includes holding an appropriate and valid visa if required. SunExpress will not provide relocation assistance

For our location in Hamburg we are seeking:

Scientist for the development of the German EOSC‑Node

Limited: 2 years | Start: earliest possible | ID: FHMA022/2026 | Deadline: 03.10.2026 | Full-time/Part-time | Remote work possible

DESY, with more than 2900 employees at its two locations in Hamburg and Zeuthen, is one of the world's leading research centres. Its research focuses on decoding the structure and function of matter, from the smallest particles of the universe to the building blocks of life. In this way, DESY contributes to solving the major questions and urgent challenges facing science, society and industry. With its ultramodern research infrastructure, its interdisciplinary research platforms and its international networks, DESY offers a highly attractive working environment in the fields of science, technology and administration as well as for the education of highly qualified young scientists.

The DESY Information Technology (IT) division participates in a wide range of high-profile national and European projects, evaluating and developing innovative IT technologies. One of its key activities is the establishment of the German EOSC Node in collaboration with ten leading research institutions across Germany as part of the National Research Data Infrastructure (NFDI). This initiative requires close coordination across more than 300 German universities and research institutions, as well as with national and European research infrastructures.
To support this ambitious endeavour, we are seeking a scientist with expertise in modern web technologies, particularly the development of user-facing web portals and backend services. The successful candidate will be motivated to contribute to the design, development, and operation of these technologies within the evolving European Open Science Cloud (EOSC) ecosystem.

About your role:

- You will contribute to the overall architecture and the design of the German NFDI EOSC Node
- You will coordinate the selection and methodology for developing a service portfolio compatible with existing requirements for the EOSC Node
- You will enhance and deploy a portal for accessing Web Services for the EOSC Node
- You will ensure that the representation of service records is harmonized and aligned with interoperability specifications in the EOSC
- You will participate in regular project meetings, workshops and conferences, both online and in person, and you will contribute to regular reports towards the project management

About you:

- You have completed a master's degree in computer science, physics or related subjects
- You have good knowledge of Web Technologies and at least one modern programming language
- Familiarity with modern cloud technologies, such as CI/CD and Kubernetes, is beneficial
- Experience with user-facing web portals, REST APIs and/or backend development is a plus
- You have good spoken and written command of the English Ianguage
- You are a collaborative team player who enjoys working in large, international teams
- You are open to travel

Good reasons to join:

Look forward to a unique working environment on our international research campus. Respectful cooperation and the well-being of our DESY employees are particularly important to us. Gender equality is an important aspect for us. To support work-life balance we offer flexible working hours, variable part-time, job-sharing models and participation in mobile work (up to 50%). You will benefit from our family-friendly and collegial atmosphere, our established health management and occupational pension provision. As a public funded employer, we offer you a secure workplace and facilitate your individual career with our comprehensive training and development opportunities. Remuneration is according to the regulations of the TV-AVH. DESY offers its employees a financial supplement for a German job ticket (Deutschland-Ticket) at both locations.

For further information, please contact Tim Wetzel at +49 40 8998‑2911 (https://tel:+494089982911)  **(Tim.Wetzel@desy.de (https://mailto:Tim.Wetzel@desy.de) ).**

Please submit your complete application documents (letter of motivation, CV and relevant certificates).

We look forward to receiving your application via our application portal:

Apply now! (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/130663)

DESY promotes equal opportunities, diversity and inclusion (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/130663/2/2544) . We therefore welcome applications from people of all dimensions of diversity. The professional development of women (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/130663/2/2820)  is very important to us and therefore we strongly encourage women to apply for the vacant position. Applications from severely disabled persons and those with equivalent status will be given preference if they are equally qualified (sbv.desy.de (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/130663/2/699) ).

You can find further information here:
https://www.desy.de/career/apprenticeship/ (https://cockpit.as-mediendesign.de/jump1/130663/2/3781)

- Strong track record of leading projects across multiple functional areas with exposure to different hierarchical levels. More extensive leadership experience is a plus
- Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills including the ability to translate technical AI concepts for executive and non-technical audiences
- Proactive, self-motivated work approach with a passion for working in teams
- Proficiency in English and preferably also in German
- Willingness to relocate to Rhine-Main-Area (e.g., Darmstadt, Frankfurt) to allow for regular office presence (2-3 days per week) for close collaboration and network building
